name: TutorMe Test Project - Authorization Document Reader v2

parameters.text:
=You are a data extraction specialist for 
authorization documents from school districts.

Extract the following fields from this 
authorization document and return ONLY a valid 
JSON object. No explanation, no markdown, 
no extra text — just the raw JSON.

Fields to extract:
{
  "student_name": "full name of student or client",
  "student_id": "client ID or UCI number",
  "authorization_number": "authorization number",
  "district": "school district or agency name",
  "service_type": "type of service authorized",
  "authorized_hours_per_month": "number only no text",
  "start_date": "MM/DD/YY format",
  "end_date": "MM/DD/YY format",
  "case_manager_name": "caseworker or case manager full name",
  "subject_areas": "subject areas or service description",
  "gross_auth_amount": "total authorized dollar amount",
  "notes": "any additional notes or comments"
  "guardian_name": "name of the guardian or parent of the student"
}

Rules:
- Return null for any field you cannot find
- Never guess or make up values
- Dates must be in MM/DD/YY format
- authorized_hours_per_month must be a number only
- Return only the JSON object nothing else

Authorization document:
{{ $json.text }}
